<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_DIYRepair" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/diy-smartphone-repair">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_DIYSmartphoneRepair" name="DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Repair" name="Repair started"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterModel" name="Enter smartphone model"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBrokenPart" name="Enter broken part"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProvideMaterialToolList" name="Provide material and tool list"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectOrderingChoice" name="Select ordering choice for each part"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckOwnedItems" name="Check owned materials and tools"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendSplit" name="Friend can lend or sell cheaply?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendJoin" name="Friend options merged"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BuyRemainingItems" name="Buy remaining materials and tools"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProvideRepairInstructions" name="Provide repair instructions"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RepairSmartphone" name="Repair the smartphone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Repair successful?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendReviewVideo" name="Send review and/or video"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send phone to expert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Repaired" name="Phone repaired"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ExpertRepair" name="Phone handed to expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterModel" targetRef="Task_EnterBrokenPart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_EnterBrokenPart" targetRef="Task_ProvideMaterialToolList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMaterialToolList" targetRef="Task_SelectOrderingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_SelectOrderingChoice" targetRef="Task_CheckOwnedItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_CheckOwnedItems" targetRef="Gateway_FriendSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendSplit" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendSplit" targetRef="Gateway_FriendJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_FriendJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendJoin" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Task_ProvideRepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ProvideRepairInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairSmartphone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_RepairSmartphone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_SendReviewVideo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SendReviewVideo" targetRef="EndEvent_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="EndEvent_ExpertRepair"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
